short: Moonshot AI's October 2026 model, built on Kimi K3, with deliberately limited hacking ability.
definition: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight AI model released by the Chinese company Moonshot AI in October 2026 as a post-trained upgrade to its earlier Kimi K3 model. Like K3, it's a large mixture-of-experts model (around 3 trillion total parameters, though only a fraction activate for any given request) with a 1-million-token context window, aimed mainly at coding and multi-step agentic tasks. Moonshot says it deliberately filtered cyberattack-related material out of the model's training data to limit its ability to find and exploit software vulnerabilities, while leaving its general coding skill intact — part of a wider industry push to restrict offensive 'cyber' capability in widely available models.
